Account status (short):
- Committed ARR: $420,000/year (contracted)
- Recent usage: down ~22% from summer peak; active projects persist in Product and Analytics teams.
- Churn signal: medium — adoption dip + Procurement redlines increases probability of extended procurement timeline.

Proposed next steps (action items):
1) Karthik/Grace: one-page stability summary to be shared with Acme Procurement by Nov 26 (we will include usage bullets, open CS tickets, and a short recommendation).
2) Naomi: Finance to confirm whether a 30-day extension or a one-time credit is permissible; if so, we will present as an option to Procurement.
3) Joint call: propose Wed, Nov 24 at 10:00 AM PT to walk the stability slide and contract points (I’ll send a calendar invite if that works).

Commercial options (for quick alignment):
- Option A (standard): Renew at committed ARR, no concession.
- Option B (stability promo): 60-day extension + one-time $10k credit applied to the first invoice upon renewal. Requires Finance sign-off.

If Procurement wants a tracked redline, we can accept reasonable language around data retention and SLAs; any pricing concession needs Finance on the thread.

I will follow up with the one-page snapshot after we incorporate Grace’s adoption bullets.

Best,
